text.traceableprint.config.missing_depen:
Cloth Config is required to open this config screen. 
Install it and try again.
text.traceableprint.title: Traceable Print Settings
text.traceableprint.option.spawnInterval:
Ticks between movement checks that may drop a new footprint. 
The per-mob spawn interval list multiplies on top of this.
text.traceableprint.option.rainAgeMultip:
Fraction of its normal lifetime an exposed footprint keeps while it is raining. 
Set 1.0 to disables the effect.
text.traceableprint.option.minDistance.@:
Minimum distance, in blocks, between two consecutive footprints. Closer steps are skipped. 
The per-mob spawn interval list multiplies on top of this.
text.traceableprint.option.printsForInvi: §cSneaking always suppresses prints regardless of this setting.
text.traceableprint.option.textureSize.@:
Base size of a footprint in blocks (square side length). 
The per-mob size list multiplies on top of this.
text.traceableprint.appearance.header: §cThe settings below apply locally only and are not affected by the server.
text.traceableprint.option.yOffset.@Tool: Unit: blocks. Does not affect the hitbox height.
Notifies a player when someone else highlights them by tracing along their footprints.
text.traceableprint.option.directionPart: Whether a highlighted footprint entity emits particles toward its target.
Footprints only appear where the block's hardness is below this value. 
Blocks in the 'Block Whitelist' bypass this check.
Common block hardness values:
moss block 0.1, dirt & sand 0.6, grass block 0.6,
rail 0.7, sandstone 0.8, stone 1.5,
cobblestone 2, raw ore 3, ore block 5.
text.traceableprint.option.applyBlocks.@:
Blocks that always allow footprints regardless of the hardness gate.
Write §9§onamespace:path§r, or §9§o#namespace:tag§r for a tag.
text.traceableprint.option.entityListInv:
Off: the entity list is a blacklist - listed mobs leave no footprints.
On: it becomes a whitelist - only listed mobs leave footprints.
text.traceableprint.option.entityList.@T:
Entity IDs, written as §9§onamespace:path§r, or use §9§o#namespace:tag§r for a whole tag.
Acts as a blacklist or a whitelist depending on 'Invert Entity List'.
text.traceableprint.per_mob.header: Each entry is '§9§onamespace:name,value§r'. Mobs do not support tags. Changes here do not affect footprints that have already spawned.
text.traceableprint.option.mobIntervalLi:
A multiplier applied to both the spawn check interval and the minimum spacing for these mobs: 
below 1 leaves prints more often and closer together, above 1 makes them sparser.
text.traceableprint.option.sizeList.@Too: Scale the footprint for specific mobs.
text.traceableprint.option.sideOffsetLis: Set the left/right offset for specific mobs.
text.traceableprint.option.forwardOffset: Set the front/back offset for specific mobs.
text.traceableprint.option.blockHeightLi: Apply an extra height offset to footprints on specific blocks.
text.traceableprint.texture.desc.format: Format: '§9§omodid:mobid,textureName1,textureName2,...§r' - the text before the first comma is the entity's registry name; everything after it is a pool of candidate texture names, and one is picked at random each time a footprint spawns.
text.traceableprint.texture.desc.path: A bare name (no colon) resolves to traceableprint:textures/entity/<name>.png. Write a full '§9§onamespace:path§r' to load art from another mod's or your own resource-pack namespace. The '.png' suffix is optional and matching is case-insensitive.
text.traceableprint.texture.desc.match: Only exact '§9§onamespace:path§r' matches apply here; tags (§9§o#namespace:tag§r) are not supported. If nothing matches, the default footprint.png is used and a warning is logged.
text.traceableprint.row_error.empty_id: The id (before the first comma) is empty.
text.traceableprint.row_error.invalid_id: Invalid id. Use '§9§onamespace:path§r', or '§9§o#namespace:tag§r' for a tag.
text.traceableprint.row_error.empty_valu: The value (after the comma) is empty.
text.traceableprint.row_error.invalid_fl: The value is not a valid number.
text.traceableprint.row_error.non_positi: The multiplier must be a positive number (0 and negative values are ignored).
text.traceableprint.row_error.empty_cand: No texture name given after the id.
text.traceableprint.row_error.duplicate_: Duplicate id - each id may appear only once; merge these entries.
